items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The four added lines match the surrounding style and include a short comment explaining why auth has to be re-attached, the same as the reference fix.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Small, focused change inside the existing function. It uses the auth field parse_url already returns, adds no helpers, and leaves no dead code or debug output.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The `if auth:` guard leaves URLs without credentials untouched. No exception handling is involved and there are no magic constants. Hidden tests pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 185/185).

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: Signature unchanged. The only change is `netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])` using parse_url's auth. There's no urllib3 pinning or Python-version check, and 'example.com/path' still becomes 'http://example.com/path'.
